ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 70% of the fluke surface, primarily in the lateral lobe regions, contrasting with low-intensity dark pixels concentrated in the central junction and trailing edge margins (approx. 30%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white/light-gray contiguous zones on the left and right lobes; a centrally located dark 'V' shaped region originating from the peduncle and extending towards the median notch; sparse dark mottling visible in the upper quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped central depression with a narrow angle and moderate pixel-depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; highest amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) occur at the lateral tips of both lobes, appearing jagged against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a generally concave curve from the median notch to the tips, while the overall lobes exhibit a broad convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white and dark circular pixel groups are visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle-induced scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct, dark diagonal linear mark is visible traversing the mid-section of the left lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular serration and perceived tissue loss on the lateral tips, suggesting significant past trauma or colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A yellowish/ochre pixel tint is localized on the upper-central region of the right lobe, distinct from the primary white-to-black pigmentation scale.
